captions.detail: The building displays a striking architectural design with a prominent, large central section composed of reflective blue glass panels that create a vibrant visual contrast against the surrounding structure. Flanking this central blue area are sections clad in beige stone or concrete, creating a balanced and symmetrical facade. Each section contains multiple rectangular windows, some of which house external air conditioning units. The top of the building features a decorative red and brown trim that adds a touch of color to the otherwise neutral tones. The name 'BHIMA'S INN' is visible at the bottom, indicating the building's purpose as a hospitality establishment.

Below the text, two pairs of feet are visible: one person wears shiny silver slip-on shoes, while the other sports dark sneakers with white laces. Both individuals are dressed in dark pants, and their lower legs and feet occupy the bottom portion of the frame. Dappled sunlight filters through overhead foliage, casting soft shadows across the tiles and creating a textured, natural pattern over the scene.

captions.detail: The scene captures a male Sandalphon from Granblue Fantasy mid-fall, his body partially submerged in a cascading waterfall. He wears dark, detailed armor with a prominent red ribbon tied around his waist, which flows dynamically through the water. His white hair is visible above the surface, and he appears to be wearing fingerless gloves. The water splashes around him in a warm, golden hue, creating a sense of motion and immersion as he drifts through the stream.

graph.short_caption: A lone figure on a futuristic motorcycle.
graph.detail_caption: A character with long, pale hair and red eyes sits atop an imposing, black motorcycle that blends retro-futuristic design with sleek, modern aesthetics. The vehicle features sharp, angular lines, exposed mechanical components, and glowing red accents that highlight its aggressive, high-tech nature. The rider, clad in thigh-high boots and a form-fitting outfit, grips the handlebars with a focused expression, embodying a sense of solitary determination against a muted purple backdrop.

captions.detail: In a dramatic scene, a blonde-haired swordsman with green eyes and a determined expression stands atop a towering crystal formation. He wears a detailed blue and red military-style coat over a white shirt, holding a katana with a green hilt. Above him, a female character in a blue and white outfit with a beret balances on his outstretched arms, her back turned to the viewer. The background features faint, classical-style statues and swirling red and blue energy ribbons, suggesting a powerful magical battle or ritual is taking place.
captions.short: A blonde swordsman and a female figure in a blue outfit stand atop a crystal formation, surrounded by magical energy.
captions.title: Blade of the Damned

descs: In a dramatic scene, a blonde-haired swordsman with green eyes and a determined expression stands atop a towering crystal formation. He wears a detailed blue and red military-style coat over a white shirt, holding a katana with a green hilt. Above him, a female character in a blue and white outfit with a beret balances on his outstretched arms, her back turned to the viewer. The background features faint, classical-style statues and swirling red and blue energy ribbons, suggesting a powerful magical battle or ritual is taking place.
A blonde swordsman and a female figure in a blue outfit stand atop a crystal formation, surrounded by magical energy.
A female figure with long, flowing hair and a serene expression, depicted in a soft, monochromatic style with subtle shading and highlights.
A female swordsman with blonde hair, wearing a blue and gold armored outfit with a bare back, holding two swords in a defensive stance.

A character wields two katanas, one in each hand, with the blades crossed behind their back. The swords feature red hilts and silver guards, contrasting with the character's blue and gold sleeve armor.
A swordsman is depicted holding a large katana with a green patterned scabbard. The figure wears a blue and gold armored outfit with a white cape flowing behind them.
A silver sword with a simple crossguard and a straight, double-edged blade is held firmly by a gloved hand. The blade reflects light, indicating a polished metal surface.
A smooth, pale human back is shown from behind, featuring a distinct vertical line down the spine. The skin appears taut and unblemished, with a hint of a blue garment at the bottom edge.
A sword with a blue hilt and a silver guard, featuring a red blade extending downwards. The handle is wrapped in blue material with gold accents.
A silver sword with a straight, double-edged blade and a simple crossguard. The hilt features a small, pointed pommel and a plain guard, resting on a surface.
A close-up view of a character with long, flowing blonde hair. The hair is styled with a side part and appears to have a slight wave, framing the face.

Swordsman 2 is positioned at the top of the composition, standing with arms outstretched. Swordsman 1 is located below and to the right of Swordsman 2, holding a sword vertically on the right side of the scene.
Both figures are depicted in an anime art style with detailed costumes and accessories.
They appear to be engaged in a dynamic pose, suggesting action or combat readiness.
The background features ornate architectural elements and glowing crystals, adding depth to the scene.
